title: Tarjetas Educativas de Vocabulario de Generación de Imágenes IA: Tarjetas Educativas Estilo Gacha Anime con Términos Bilingües
prompt: Design a set of four educational vocabulary flashcards. Each card should include one English word related to AI image generation technology, its Japanese katakana equivalent, phonetic transcription, a simple text explanation, an image-based visual explanation, and an example sentence demonstrating usage. The card design should follow a 2D anime-style aesthetic inspired by Japanese mobile gacha games featuring beautiful character artwork. The four AI terms to feature are: Diffusion, Latent Space, Inference, and Checkpoint. Each card should have vibrant colors, elegant typography, decorative borders, and a character illustration that thematically represents the concept.
